title: sarga trichoclada
intro: Sarga trichoclada, commonly known as the "Indian sarpagandha" or "small sarpagandha", is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including stress, anxiety, and insomnia, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant has been found to have therapeutic actions such as sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of Sarga trichoclada have been reported to include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
